name: bandit.phase4_visibility_road_night_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live neutral-weather night road row. A real idle camp dispatches an abstract exact pair toward three concrete hostile entities; from the exact concealed watch, the production trace must expose its generated weather identity, retain a neutral sight penalty, derive the one-point ordinary night budget, and fail to acquire the distance-three target.

steps.label: post_load_phase4_visibility_road_night_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the night road/horde fixture reaches normal gameplay; this is startup footing only
steps.failure_rule: If gameplay does not load, no live visibility proof can be credited.

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_road_night_site
steps.abort_reason: saved state did not contain the idle five-member camp and exact road lead before the visibility run
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members and one fixture-known road terrain opportunity are idle before production dispatch

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_road_night_horde
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap metadata did not contain three concrete hostile entities on the exact road target OMT
steps.expected_immediate_state: three distinct concrete mon_zombie entities occupy the exact committed target OMT before runtime

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_phase4_visibility_road_night_due
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: six real game hours pass while production initializes the exact camp's routine activation clock
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded wait does not complete, the deterministic dispatch window is not reached.

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_for_phase4_visibility_road_night_dispatch
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the real hourly cadence crosses the exact camp's due boundary and dispatches an exact pair toward the naturally confirmed road target
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait lacks the exact dispatch artifact, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_first_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_road_night_approach
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the first real post-dispatch hour advances the pair to its canonical approach OMT; approach and exact-watch arrival remain separate owner transitions
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded post-dispatch wait does not reach scheduler hour 167 at minute 10020, the serialized approach transition is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_second_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_road_night_observer
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the second real post-dispatch hour reaches the selected exact watch and runs the production one-point night visibility read with its generated weather identity exposed
steps.failure_rule: If the second bounded post-dispatch wait lacks a visibility artifact at scheduler hour 168 and minute 10080, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_road_night_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug delta did not prove the exact night watch, generated weather token, neutral sight penalty, and distance-three negative visibility outcome
steps.failure_rule: No night-row credit if dispatch, generated weather identity, neutral sight penalty, and exact-watch negative visibility outcome are not present on same-run lines.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_road_night_no_fixture_optic
steps.abort_reason: the no-optic road fixture produced an optical visibility trace
steps.failure_rule: Unexpected optics invalidate this ordinary-night contrast.

evidence_contract.claim: a real abstract exact pair reaches its concealed watch, exposes its generated weather identity, and derives a one-point ordinary night budget with sight penalty 1 that cannot acquire the distance-three concrete road target without fixture optics or player-coordinate input
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for structural visibility
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 night-row credit unless startup, exact idle terrain-opportunity lead, exact three-entity target footing, elapsed production dispatch, serialized approach and watch arrival, generated weather identity, neutral sight penalty, one-point observer budget, distance-three non-acquisition, no-visible-threat outcome, and no-optic control are separately green.
